findings.issue: The only characterization of `differentialOperatorsOneEquivComplexifiedVectorFieldProd.symm` and its principal symbol (line ~520) needs the field written as `1 ⊗ₜ X + Complex.I ⊗ₜ Y`. summary: The complex principal-symbol API lacks the boundary-free order-drop lemmas that the real-case file provides, and the simp lemmas for the order-one splitting only fire on the literal `1 ⊗ₜ X + I ⊗ₜ Y` form, so a general complexified field has no simp normal form.
